instruction: Configure VSCode so it automatically toggles between workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace every 30 seconds, keeping all open files intact.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VSCode does not have any built-in functionality to automatically switch between workspaces on a timer. When you switch workspaces, the current window is closed and reopened with the new workspace, losing all state. There's no setting or extension that can maintain open files while switching workspaces automatically.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible()' marker for a genuinely impossible task
Instruction requires VSCode to auto-switch workspaces every 30 seconds without closing files, which is architecturally impossible in VSCode
When switching workspaces, VSCode must close and reopen the window, losing all state - no built-in or extension-based solution exists
The metadata provides accurate technical reasoning for why this task cannot be completed
